title: shadcn/improve
claim: shadcn/improve — Use your most capable model to audit your codebase and write plans for cheaper models to execute.
why_good: The project addresses the growing need for cost-effective AI model management, helping companies optimize their resources.
value: Businesses could pay for subscription plans to access advanced auditing features and tailored optimization recommendations.
risk: If larger AI service providers integrate similar functionalities into their platforms, it could overshadow this tool.
